text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
A Fan Fest featuring a variety of<n>events is held for
the Umamusume's<n>most ardent supporters.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Taiki Shuttle is all pumped up for the<n>festivities,
hoping to keep her fans<n>entertained.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yeehaw! The energy here is really<n>buzzing!
Everybody looks like<n>they're havin' a blast!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
And my time to shine is comin' up<n>soon! I'm gonna
put big smiles on<n>everybody's faces!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh... I'll be runnin' in a pretty<n>exciting race!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
It's called the Carrot Crunch Dash.<n>Ya gotta get to
the finish line after<n>eatin' all the carrots in your
way!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I know how to run, and I sure know<n>how to eat! I'm
shootin' for victory!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: The carrot dash eventually sets into<n>motion...

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text: Everyone is off to a beautiful start!But who among them knows howbest to maintain their speed and appetite?!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Taiki Shuttle has had great results on<n>both turf and
dirt. I'm looking forward<n>to seeing how she does
today.
choice_data_list: She won't lose, no matter the race.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I'm starting to understand how<n>she's made
it this far.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: She has such a trusting trainer by her<n>side.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It's necessary for both trainer and<n>Umamusume to
be in sync. Without<n>trust, I won't be able to make
her<n>dream a reality.

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Our participants will arrive at their first<n>carrot
shortly! They must finish the<n>whole thing before
they can move on!

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Each racer has launched into a clean,<n>precise jump
to snatch their carrot<n>out of the air!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Taiki latches onto the carrot hanging<n>above her lane
and starts eating it.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: This should be child's play forher—she's an Umamusume who canspeed down a track and through ameal!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Or so I thought...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Whoa! This carrot is so delicious!

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
What a development! Everyone has<n>slowed down
considerably!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Don't tell me... Were those carrots<n>brought in from
Aichi?!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
They're carrots of fable, laden with
sugar—supposedly sweeter than<n>watermelons...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
They taste even sweeter the more<n>you chew, until
all you want to do is<n>continue savoring their flavor.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
With something so exquisite on the<n>track... we may
no longer have a race<n>on our hands!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I'm not a hundred percent sure<n>what's going on,
but judging by<n>Tazuna's reaction, finishing the
carrots is likely no easy feat.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: And so...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh... I lost. That carrot was just too<n>darn tasty...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
But hey, at least my fans seemed to<n>get a kick
outta the whole shebang!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
It was probably just as fun as<n>watchin' a ra—no!
No, no, no! I gotta<n>entertain 'em even more from
here<n>out!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: The Fan Fest has given Taiki a burst<n>of motivation.

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: You can do it, Taiki Shuttle!

text_block_list.name: Garoto B
text_block_list.text: Go, Taiki! Keep running!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, what am I doing?! Have I just<n>been standin'
here eating this<n>carrot?!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I don't wanna be happy all on myown! I gotta make everybody happy!

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Oh, what's this? Taiki Shuttle has<n>taken the lead!
She's running full<n>steam ahead!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: And so...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I'm number one! Thanks for all the<n>support, y'all!

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: Wow, that was amazing! You're so<n>fast!

text_block_list.name: Garoto B
text_block_list.text: Hey, Taiki! I'll cheer you on in your<n>next race too!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Okay! I won't let y'all down!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Taiki Shuttle has a crowd of fans<n>around her.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She's steadily sprinting her way into<n>everyone's
hearts.
